_comment: PC ARGB simulation layout — M5StickC TFT (40x80) + WS2812B 8x32 matrix

TFT 40x80 virtual (bus0, y:0-80).y:2-22: RAD1 | RAD2(rev) | RAD3  — 360mm radiator, 3x 120mm fans (13x20 each)
TFT 40x80 virtual (bus0, y:0-80).y:24-44: CPU(20x20) | CASE1(9x20) | CASE2(9x20,rev)  — CPU block + 2 case fans
TFT 40x80 virtual (bus0, y:0-80).y:46-58: STRIP1 (38x12)  — 1D addressable strip A (TFT visualiser only)
TFT 40x80 virtual (bus0, y:0-80).y:60-72: STRIP2 (38x12, rev)  — 1D addressable strip B (TFT visualiser only)
TFT 40x80 virtual (bus0, y:0-80).y:72-80: Preview (32x8)  — Copy Segment strip showing WS matrix overview

WS2812B 8x32 (bus1, y:80-112).y:80-88: WS_A (8x8, 64 LEDs)  — zone A, rainbow fwd
WS2812B 8x32 (bus1, y:80-112).y:88-96: WS_B (8x8, 64 LEDs)  — zone B, rainbow rev
WS2812B 8x32 (bus1, y:80-112).y:96-104: WS_C (8x8, 64 LEDs)  — zone C, rainbow fwd
WS2812B 8x32 (bus1, y:80-112).y:104-112: WS_D (8x8, 64 LEDs)  — zone D, rainbow rev

Key findings.WS 8x8 blocks: 4 equal 8x8 sub-segments of the 8x32 panel, confirmed working with solid-colour test
Key findings.Copy Segment cross-bus: o2=true required when source segment is on a different bus (reads global frame buffer)
Key findings.o1=true: swaps axes — use for portrait->landscape rotation in Copy Segment
Key findings.WS panel orientation: physical matrix is landscape (32 wide x 8 tall); WLED config is portrait (8x32); WLED x=physical row, WLED y=physical column
